description: A mature DID (200 days, m = 1) with perfect dimension scores is still capped while in probation. Probation lifts only when verified_interactions >= 100 AND age_days >= 30; here the age condition is met but only 40 interactions are recorded. cap = round(50 + 50 x min(1, 40/100)) = 70, so effective = min(100, 70) = 70. This is the trust-laundering guard: age alone does not lift the cap.
